import numpy as np

# Data from Treasury Bulletin tables (FY 1953-1962)
# Gold = independent variable (X), Silver = dependent variable (Y)

years = [1953, 1954, 1955, 1956, 1957, 1958, 1959, 1960, 1961, 1962]
gold = np.array([22462.8, 21927.0, 21677.6, 21799.1, 22622.9, 21356.2, 19704.6, 19322.2, 17550.2, 16435.2])
silver = np.array([3814.3, 3863.1, 3922.4, 3994.5, 4116.6, 4306.0, 4414.1, 4394.5, 4346.5, 4317.4])

print("Data for FY 1953-1962:")
print(f"{'Year':<6} {'Gold (X)':>12} {'Silver (Y)':>12}")
for y, g, s in zip(years, gold, silver):
    print(f"{y:<6} {g:>12.1f} {s:>12.1f}")

# Calculate linear regression: silver = a + b*gold
n = len(gold)
sum_x = np.sum(gold)
sum_y = np.sum(silver)
sum_xy = np.sum(gold * silver)
sum_x2 = np.sum(gold ** 2)
sum_y2 = np.sum(silver ** 2)

# Regression coefficients
b = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_x2 - sum_x ** 2)
a = (sum_y - b * sum_x) / n

print(f"\nRegression: Silver = {a:.4f} + {b:.6f} * Gold")

# Calculate R²
# R² = SSR/SST = 1 - SSE/SST
y_pred = a + b * gold
ss_tot = np.sum((silver - np.mean(silver)) ** 2)
ss_res = np.sum((silver - y_pred) ** 2)
r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)

print(f"\nSum of squares total (SST): {ss_tot:.4f}")
print(f"Sum of squares residual (SSE): {ss_res:.4f}")
print(f"R² = {r_squared:.6f}")
print(f"R² (rounded to 2 decimals): {round(r_squared, 2)}")

# Also calculate correlation coefficient for verification
r = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / np.sqrt((n * sum_x2 - sum_x**2) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y**2))
print(f"\nCorrelation coefficient r = {r:.6f}")
print(f"r² = {r**2:.6f}")

# Verify R² from correlation
print(f"\nFinal Answer: R² = {round(r_squared, 2)}")
EOF

for y, g, s in zip(years, gold, silver):

# Calculate linear regression: silver = a + b*gold
n = len(gold)
sum_x = sum(gold)
sum_y = sum(silver)
sum_xy = sum(g * s for g, s in zip(gold, silver))
sum_x2 = sum(g ** 2 for g in gold)
sum_y2 = sum(s ** 2 for s in silver)

print(f"\nSummations:")
print(f"n = {n}")
print(f"sum_x = {sum_x}")
print(f"sum_y = {sum_y}")
print(f"sum_xy = {sum_xy}")

mean_y = sum_y / n

print(f"Sum of squares total (SST): {ss_tot:.4f}")
print(f"Sum of squares residual (SSE): {ss_res:.4f}")
print(f"R² = {r_squared:.6f}")
print(f"R² (rounded to 2 decimals): {round(r_squared, 2)}")

# Also calculate correlation coefficient for verification
numerator = n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y
denominator = math.sqrt((n * sum_x2 - sum_x**2) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y**2))
r = numerator / denominator
